They pay attention to detail.Quick Fix did the install in less than a day and did a tidy job. They installed the wiring down the wall cavity so no surface cables. They even came back to install a shade over the inverter which was unexpected. They sent me photos of the install after the job.Quick Fix initiated the meter change process for the tenants after the install. They had good communication and were timely in responding to questions over the phone or email

From initial contact, through the site visit and system design process, system installation and finally post-installation support, Luke and the team at Quick Fix could not be faulted.I received quotes from 7 different installers and Luke stood out head and shoulders above all the competition. He offers a wide range of premium panel and inverter options, and the price was the best value for money system, easily!Nothing was too hard for Luke, from attending the visit on site to talk through options, questions and special requests was no issue and getting up on the roof to measure out the layout exactly with some unique aspects to our roofline, and amending quotes at any time of the day. And he's the one on the roof with his team installing the system, so you're not left talking to a sales rep trying to get a handle on what the experience and quality of the actual installer will be like.Above and beyond would be the most apt description for the whole experience! Removing an old satellite TV dish, relocating the antenna away from panels, and seeing to a minor separate electrical job on site were all included at no extra charge and done on the day of installation.The system itself has been very impressive, from both the aesthetic and performance of the Full Black WST-370MG Winaico panels combined with the Genesis SolarEdge inverter.Luke have the team have since visited us again twice to make sure the system was running as expected, and then to install the consumption monitoring meter to complete the impressive real-time SolarEdge monitoring platform.Finally, I commend Luke for the conscious ethical decisions he makes that shapes the selection of panel brands he chooses to partner with.If you are looking for a solar installation of the highest quality in not only service, but product and performance, look no further than Luke and the team. After a very rigorous process of quoting and comparing, no one compares to Quick Fix! We could not be happier. A huge thanks again to Luke and the boys.
